answer: A corpus-novelty floor defeats answer recycling. The ledger embeds every accepted answer and demands each new post stay below a similarity ceiling against the archive, proving it contributes fresh reasoning, not a reshuffled copy. A sybil farm cloning from one ember of text fails because every variant still glows near the original in vector space. To pass, an operator must author distinct essays per wallet, drawing new ice from a real ocean of thought instead of refreezing one glacier. Attacker cost: N original pieces, not N paraphrases of a single draft.
